focus_case: (1,1,8192,1024) BLOCK_SHARDED shard[1024,128] grid(8,8) bf16/HiFi2/fp32_acc_off/TILE/bf16 TILE gamma
plan: s=8 hidden slices, S=4 hidden tiles/core, B=8 block_rows, 4 blocks, 32 shard row-tiles/core, 64 cores = 8 row-groups x 8
coverage: 100 markers max of 250 cap; last user zone ends at 1.00 of KERNEL span on every RISC
ranked_bottleneck: the row-group ROOT serializes the whole group: 56 of 64 cores idle 84% of the wall in rd_bcast_recv waiting for the root; the root pays a 64-fp32-tile REDUCE per block (256 tiles = 1 MB of stat traffic per root core) plus a 1 MB incast

method: cumulative peel, payload stubbed, CB+semaphore+barrier scaffolding kept, one fresh-cache profiled run each
verdict: the combine (root reduce 42.0 us + incast 12.0 us) IS the excess; floor+local = 19578 ns is already BELOW the 25640 reference, so the target is reachable by fixing the combine alone

roofline_gate.incast: 1 MB of fp32 stat tiles into ONE core = 87 GB/s measured ~ single-core L1 write-port roofline -> no transfer-level lever, only fewer bytes or more destinations
roofline_gate.root_reduce: 256 fp32 stat tiles (1 MB) per root core; information content is 8192 fp32 (32 KB) = 32x over-shipped
roofline_gate.local_compute: ~768 KB of L1 traffic in 7.5 us ~ 100 GB/s ~ L1 roofline; at most one pass (~2.5 us) removable by fusion

domain: every s>1 with min(s,B)>1; carve-out min(s,B)==1 (measured regression -9%/-5%) which IS the flat root parameterized at num_owners=1
helper_bypass: none needed for the recommended option
side_benefit: gather landing CB s*B -> s*(B/min(s,B)) pages = 32 KB vs 1 MB, unlocking coarser block_rows and I4
trap: noc_semaphore_inc_multicast as the gather signal inverts the result on 2-D groups (s=32: 149716 vs 31073) - use per-owner unicast atomics

idea: I2 two-level tree combine on the row-group rect
domain: every rect and both line orientations with s*B>=16; carve-out s*B==8 (measured regression 0.93x/0.96x/0.88x)
helper_bypass: raw pairwise add_tiles(acc_to_dest) for level 1 - capability gap: ReduceWithinTile::Skip unreachable (static_assert at reduce_helpers_compute.inl:885-891 sits AFTER the AccumulateViaAdd early-return)
note: a tree on a 1-D line does NOT degenerate (1.124x at 8x1); DEST holds B tiles at level 1 so fp32_dest_acc_en=True needs chunking at DEST_AUTO_LIMIT=4

idea: I3 compact transposed 128 B stat gather
mechanism: halving payload bytes alone is a NULL, so the root cost is TILE COUNT its unpacker chews, not bytes in flight
domain: every s>=4; carve-out s<=3 (measured regression); s>32 works via ceil(s/32) landing tiles
helper_bypass: raw reduce+transpose_dest window - capability: no transpose helper in kernel_lib at all, and post_reduce_op cannot re-init MATH
must_ship_with: a cross-core SEM_LANDING_READY edge - the root zeroing un-owned landing lanes raced contributors writes and wiped landed partials (stat_pcc 0.048)

idea: I4 software-pipeline the block loop / fewer combine round trips
verdict: WIN (pipeline) + WIN-small (coarser stat) + NULL (decoupling stat from apply)

isolated_ns.coarse16_b8: 66043 (NULL vs base_b16 - decoupling buys nothing on a resident shard)

domain: every hidden-split plan with >1 combine round trip; flat (not excluded) at 1 round trip; BLOCKED by L1 beyond stat_rows=8 at s=8 (depth-2 landing needs 1410 KB vs a measured ~937 KB CB region)
note: the two levers are SUBSTITUTES not additive; the pipeline is strictly better; its L1 term is the s x SB fp32 landing buffer, which I1/I3 shrink

idea: I5 fuse scale+gamma into one DEST window (non-DEST_TO_SRCA mechanisms)
verdict: NULL for the idea as floated (every fusion mechanism REGRESSES) + WIN for what the investigation found instead
mechanism: this stage is MATH-thread-bound and the L1 crossings are FREE (PACK/UNPACK overlap MATH); two FPU ops/tile is the floor

win_found.option: interm_cb_bulk - replace the in-place pack + sync_pack_to_unpack with a one-block intermediate CB whose own push/wait IS the PACK->UNPACK edge
win_found.cost: BLOCK_TILES extra L1 pages (64 KB at focus)

bugs_found: ckl::DestReuseBinary returns WRONG DATA when block_size == DEST_AUTO_LIMIT (pcc 0.9866) - the parked GAMMA_FUSED path would be silently wrong on any S making DEST_BLOCK 8, incl. the perf-flagged (1,1,32,7168) at S=8; keep it off
sfpu_binary_bcast.h documents an fp32_dest_acc_en=True requirement that is not real (pcc 0.99999 at False)

knobs.DEST_BLOCK_TILES: 4 beats 8 by 4% at S=8/16 and is free at S=4/5
knobs.DEST_BLOCK_MIN_ROW_TILES=2 gate: costs ~2% at R=1, no measurable benefit
knobs.OUT_CB_DEPTH: irrelevant on TILE+sharded (cb_output_tiles IS the shard)
